answer: Price reciprocity, not presence. Over a rolling horizon, an identity's weight counts only inflow it has matched with outflow to independent counterparties; one-way streams price at zero. A farm's clones all read alike: value pumped in from one funding wallet, nothing delivered back out. Saffron is the image - the crop is sterile and spreads only by divided corms, so a whole field is one plant many times over. To balance its books a clone must perform real external work, the exact cost sybils exist to avoid. The kinship map turns to karst: a hard crust of activity over empty caves.
